title: finding(app-shell): DefaultRegisterPage passes no errorMessages to RegisterForm, so every sign-up refusal (user-exists and the audience gate codes) shows the server raw English message — the objectui#10998 family on the exported page
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11029 (`Fixes #10998`). The dev reported it as an out-of-scope finding in report `os-dev-report` on objectui#10998. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## The gap

objectui#10998 fixed the console app's own register page: `apps/console/src/pages/auth/RegisterPage.tsx` now maps `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` and `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`, beside the user-exists codes, to pack text.

`@object-ui/app-shell` exports a second register page:
- `DefaultRegisterPage`, re-exported from `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/RegisterPage.tsx`;
- mounted at `/register` by `examples/console-starter`.

Read from source at objectui `origin/main`, it renders `RegisterForm` with **no `errorMessages` map at all**. `RegisterForm`'s catch reads `(code && errorMessages?.[code]) || authError.message`, so on that page every sign-up refusal shows the server's own message:
- the user-exists codes;
- `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`, whose message is English and names the internal setting "audience posture invite_only";
- `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`.

Every locale gets that raw message.

## Evidence level

Read from source only. It has not been reproduced at a running door, so no reach class is claimed here. The server side is measured, in PR objectui#11029's report: objectstack's `/sign-up/email` before-hook answers `403` with both codes, and an undeclared posture defaults to `invite_only`.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

The smallest repair is to pass the same code map the console page now passes, using the pack keys PR objectui#11029 added: `auth.register.errors.userExists`, `.selfRegistrationClosed` and `.emailDomainNotAllowed`. Pin it under zh-CN, and pin the unknown-code fallback, as PR objectui#11029's test does. Whether the two pages should share one map is a design choice for the claimant.

Related, left unmapped on purpose: the same door's `AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR` carries an operator-facing message and renders raw on both pages.

Dedupe words: DefaultRegisterPage errorMessages, app-shell register refusal raw message, console-starter register localized error, SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED app-shell.
